reviews.x: I bought this for straightening my beard and this thing works great! Heats up in 1 minute and is ready to rock n roll. One thing to note is the temperature only goes up to 200 degrees, but works great on beards and my girlfriend loves using for her VERY long hair. Highly recommend this product!

reviews.t: Do not show your wife or daughter or it will belong to them
reviews.x: Bought this for my manly red beard. As I tried it I made the mistake to show my wife and daughter how amazingly simple and perfectly it worked. Before I could set it down my wife ripped it out of my hand to “try” and see if it worked on her hair. 5 mins later I am starting at her perfectly straight hair realizing my mistake. Sure we could share, but we all know that she will leave the abundance of fallen hair soldiers just like all the other brushes around my house. Well at least today I had a s

I bought this to finally tame my sons crazy hair. I comb his hair to the side and keep it that way. Hair is like wax, you can form it while it's warm. Its quick and easy for the hectic mornings. It goes up to 200 fast you won't be wasting much time. 👍

I have mainly used this brush to style and smooth out my hair after sleeping on it.  I wear a medium length bob, and have thick hair. I am almost 60 years old, so my hair is coarser now. I was thrilled at the first time  I used it. I thought it really wouldn’t do much. I was able to run the brush through my hair and let the ends roll over the brush. Presto, a quick brush through and my hair looked great. This will save me time and I think it will save my hair in the long run, as I would often us
Worst product ever; since I’ve received it, I get an error after two minutes of turning it on. very disappointing.

reviews.t: Product Fail - Look elsewhere - huge disappointment.
reviews.x: Horrible place for the on/off/temperature button.  It is impossible to use the product without constantly bumping it over and over.  Directions in package show the image of this brush, but are written for a clamp style hot iron.  Not sure how to straighten the hair close to the scalp.  Just seems like this company could care less about quality.  I don't have time to return and replace this before a trip otherwise I would send it back immediately.

reviews.t: It works and easy to use
reviews.x: This brush heats up fast and worked for my hair, I only needed it for quick fix ups in the morning and I have been using it for a few days and it has saved me time and effort.

I was skeptical like everyone else to purchase this item, but I'm glad I did! My hair looks amazing every time I use it after my shower, I let my hair air dry first and then I start to straighten it. The best part about it, is that my hair isnt getting burnt from the tip, usually that's what the flat iron does to my hair.
Love it! Exactly what i needed for my wavey beard! Great investment..

reviews.t: The best beard straightening brush I've ever
reviews.x: truth be told I have only used one but this is the only one I need to use from the performance that it is all really giving me a few times. It has three settings and I put mine on 355 I believe or whatever the middle setting is and I slowly brush my beard and it straightens it with perfection after about five or six go-rounds. There is a couple of brushes on the market for $100 or so which I think is ridiculous. This was about $27 and it works just as good as them. And the other ones are so smal

As an African-American woman with kinky/coily natural hair I didn't have high hopes for this brush, but it was a good price and I figured if it didn't work I wouldn't be out of a lot of money and I could pass it on to a friend with a straighter hair texture than mine.  I bought it to use to prep my hair for a sew-in as I like to shampoo and deep condition my hair myself to make sure I'm getting good moisture to my hair before an install, and I used this after blow drying my hair.  Blow drying is

reviews.t: Easy enough for my 12 year old daughter.
reviews.x: I purchased this for my 12 year old daughter who struggles with a regular straightener. She lives with her dad so she needed something easy she could do herself before school with out me there. We practiced the first day together and by the second day she could do it alone. Very easy..she does half to comb through her hair first BC it won't do through tangled.. But besides that stays hot and does the job relatively quick.  Also heats quick anf the way it's made it would be hard to burn yourself.

This was my first time buying a straightening brush and I am impressed! I have thick hair so I took it in small sections at first but got lazy and by the end was just brushing my hair, you do have to hold the bottom of your hair taut and work the brush from top to bottom. It gets up to 390d (F) and works fast. It took me about 7-10 minutes to straighten all my hair. Overall, I would definitely recommend. I got it in Prime day on a whim & really glad I took a chance!

I would give the product 5 stars but I definitely noticed the lack of something to press up against. With a normal straightener the hair is forced to stay in place due to the 2 sides holding the hair but without the second side to the brush straightener, hair seems to try and escape. For thin hair like the blonde, it’s almost easier to use a regular straightener but with thick hair like the brunette, this is VERY convenient.

reviews.t: Would not recommend, doesn't stay on...
reviews.x: This would probably be a decent product if it didn't turn off automatically every five seconds. Doesn't even let you select the temp half the time without just turning off too. I've tried letting it "warm up" and then selecting the temp but nothing. I've tried over and over hoping it would work but I just ended up throwing it away this morning.

I really think this is the worst brush I ever try. I would keep my hair straightener... the brush is heavy and the bristles are too big and it hurts my scalp. The hair does dry, but it gets pluffy (like Monica in the Bahamas, from friends). I knew it wasn’t going to be the best brush, I was cheap, but this is worst than I thought:

reviews.t: That it doesn't straighten that good
reviews.x: It heats up quick only down fall to this is that it really dosent straighten the hair well didn't really straighten mine or my sister hair other that everything was good just didn't like that it didn't straighten the only way you can is if your taking small section of your hair and if you keep going threw it a lot but it's alright

I bought this for my husband for Father's Day. He had been looking at them on and off for over six months. After all that research, I purchased this one. He is very happy with it. It straightens and smooths his beard. I tried using it on my daughter's thick, coarse blonde hair and it worked pretty well for that too.

I got this for my thick shoulder length hair as it takes so long to straighten it.  This works and my hair is straight but not as flat as it is when using a straightener. It is also much easier to use so saves time as I just need to brush my hair. No more separating sections and moving through my hair bit by bit.

Love this straightening brush.! I use it to straighten my beard and it works great. My beard is super curly and this has it stright and looking good in only minutes. I like that it has 5 different heat settings as well. Recommend this to anyone looking to straighten their beard quickly.

reviews.t: Great for the price straitens my beard as expected
reviews.x: The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is it smells funny when you turn it on. My girlfriend says it smells like scrambled eggs. So that being said after using it I have to put some stuff in my beard to help the smell. Other than that this thing works great.

Brush works great. I have thin curly frizzy hair. I run this through my hair, takes about 5 minutes (dry hair). No frizz, no curls. Super soft, silky hair. It takes no time to heat up. If you're looking for a faster way to tame the mane, then I recommend.

reviews.t: So far so good - Keeps the beard at bay.
reviews.x: I bought this to use as a beard straightener.  While it doesn't get quite as close as other brushes sold specifically for that purpose, this one seems to  be of a better quality.  So far, it's working great and I have had no issues with it.
Super easy to use. Only complaint is that the brush has pulled on my hair quite a bit which I don't appreciate. Otherwise it straightens really well and fast.
Does everything I need it to. I bought it to straighten my beard and it works perfectly. Don’t waste money on a beard straightener get one of these instead.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the brush heats up quickly, making it fast and convenient to use.
Several reviewers report it works well for beard straightening.
Multiple reviewers find it easy to use, including for a child to operate independently.
Some reviewers report the product turns off or errors out unexpectedly, making it unusable.
A few reviewers note the brush lacks a second side to hold hair in place, so hair can escape.
